assertions.preferred_statement: fine-tuning geneformer significantly boosts predictive accuracy for transcription factor regulatory range compared to alternative methods.

tahoe-100m is the largest single-cell dataset to date enabling ai-driven models to learn context-dependent gene functions.

gears significantly outperforms all baseline methods in predicting single-gene perturbation transcriptional responses on both rpe-1 and k562 datasets with m.s.e. improvement of 30-50% and pearson correlation more than double that of baselines.
gears outperforms baseline methods in predicting two-gene perturbation outcomes across all generalization classes with over 30% improvement in m.s.e. and 50% greater enrichment for top de genes.
cellot outperforms current methods scgen cae popalign at predicting single-cell drug responses across both 4i and scrna-seq data modalities.
crop-seq identifies known activators lck zap70 lat and repressors ptpn6 ptpn11 egr3 of tcr signaling in jurkat cells validated by bulk rna-seq and flow cytometry.
geneformer encodes network hierarchy in its attention weights in a completely self-supervised manner during pretraining.

scfoundation-based model for drug response prediction achieved high pearson and spearman correlations with higher clustering scores ch sil compared to gene expression baseline and enabled better transfer between bulk and single-cell data.
genecompass achieves auroc of 0.95 in gene dosage sensitivity prediction outperforming geneformer.
larger pretraining data sizes yield superior pretrained embeddings and improved downstream task performance but cellular context alignment is also important.
sci-plex can identify compounds that target convergent pathways by comparing single-cell transcriptional responses as evidenced by the similarity between mek and hsp90 inhibitor signatures.

gears significantly outperforms cpa in predicting non-additive combinatorial perturbation effects across multiple genetic interaction subtypes with correlation coefficients 0.4 vs 0.0 and precision 10 improvements >40% for four of five subtypes.

scgpt outperforms tosica and scbert in cell type annotation across multiple datasets.

the global transcriptional response to hdac inhibitors is consistent with induction of an acetyl-coa-deprived state as supported by upregulation of acetyl-coa synthesis enzymes and blocking of the response by acetyl-coa precursors.
mosaic-seq can efficiently genotype sgrnas in single cells with low barcode contamination rate.
experimental validation confirms nr5a1 and gata4 overexpression in hescs activates gonadal gene programs demonstrating genecompass s ability to predict key regulators of cell fate.
cell line identity and cell cycle phase are the major factors driving stratification in the tahoe-100m transcriptomic data.
attentionpert achieves superior performance in predicting out-of-distribution multi-gene perturbations where none of the perturbed genes are seen during training.
scgpt captures gene networks that align with known functional groups and identifies cell-type-specific gene programs.
scdca consistently outperforms naive fine-tuning of scgpt across all tasks with the performance gap widening for more challenging tasks such as few-shot and zero-shot settings.
cellot captures cell-to-cell variability and heterogeneous subpopulation structures better than autoencoder-based methods.

scgpt outperforms seurat v.4 and scglue in multi-omic integration.
combining pertweight and pertlocal encoders yields synergistic improvement over using either alone.
